title: Pharmacokinetics Study of Donepezil HCl in Subjects Receiving Haemodialysis.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the pharmacokinetics of donepezil HCl 3 mg in subjects with end-state renal disease who were receiving haemodialysis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

Subjects with end-stage renal disease who were receiving haemodialysis. Subject who are able and willing to give written informed consent.

Exclusion criteria:

Subjects with known hypersensitivity to drugs or foods. Subjects with a corrected QT interval greater than 450 msec at Screening period.
